scope: Current controller read-only field readiness and local artifact inventory; no network configuration or flight commands
probe_limit: One 0.5-second TCP probe per configured endpoint; timeout is not proof the device is powered off
inventory_limit: Filename inventory only; does not establish absence of user recordings elsewhere or under different names

current_release_dataset.limitation: No positive truth/prediction in required positive strata; deployment coverage and independent review incomplete

required_external_inputs: Connect this controller to the actual field network and provide the correct endpoint/interface mapping if different
Provide six-stratum deployment recordings with source attestations, target annotations and independent review
Perform required operator visual and HIL/REAL three-airframe acceptance with the actual devices
